AND t_listed.status LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
AND t_listed.listed_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.listedNo}, '%')
AND t_listed.listed_mode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.listedMode}, '%')
AND t_listed.listed_price LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.listedPrice}, '%')

AND t_listed.price_model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.priceModel}, '%')

AND t_listed.distribution_way LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.distributionWay}, '%')
